name: Sona
notes: Crescendo is cast at t=0 as the opening move; its 350(+50%AP)-class damage lands after its 0.25s cast, via a scheduled event, and never recasts because its cooldown vastly exceeds the fight length.

Hymn of Valor sends two bolts to the two nearest visible enemies; against a single dummy only one bolt finds a target, so each Q cast deals one instance of its direct damage, arms one instance of its 5s on-hit bonus tag, and grants one Accelerando stack (one champion hit).

Hymn of Valor, Aria of Perseverance and Song of Celerity are all cast the moment their own cooldown (reduced by ability haste, including Accelerando's) is up; none has a cast time so none locks out attacks, but casting any one of them puts the other two on Melody's 0.5s shared cooldown.

Every basic ability cast (Q, W or E, not R) adds a permanent Power Chord stack; at 3 stacks the stacks reset to 0, the next basic attack is armed as empowered, and gaining the empowerment immediately resets Sona's attack timer (never earlier than an active cast lockout, e.g. Crescendo's opening 0.25s).

Power Chord's bonus on-hit magic damage uses the higher Staccato value only if the ability that completed the 3rd stack was Hymn of Valor; this is decided once, at the moment the 3rd stack lands, and is not re-checked at the moment the attack actually lands.

Aria of Perseverance's Diminuendo (damage-dealt reduction) and Song of Celerity's Tempo (slow) do not change the dummy's damage output or Sona's own damage, since the dummy never attacks; they are not modeled beyond still contributing a Power Chord stack and, if last cast, arming the base (non-Staccato) Power Chord bonus.

Aria of Perseverance's self-heal is not counted as healing or shielding a wounded ally (there are no allies in this fight), so it never grants an Accelerando stack; only Hymn of Valor connecting with the dummy grants Accelerando stacks, which feed Accelerando's ability haste (capped at 60 AH) applied on top of the build's own haste.
Accelerando's current-cooldown reduction to Crescendo at max stacks is not modeled since Crescendo is only ever cast once, long before its cooldown could matter again.
Mana costs are not modeled: nothing in this rotation would exhaust Sona's mana pool inside a 15 s fight at level 16.
